I will do this bean plot the same way I trusted before, because it is rented land and I do not want to put much cash into it. Around here most people do not buy fertilizer or spray for beans unless they have extra money, and I have not seen that pay well on a rented plot like this. I will keep my money, use my own seed, and work it mostly with family labor, only bringing a few people if we fall behind at weeding or harvest.
